# Instructions

Work from `workspace/`. Read `workspace/AGENTS.md` first — it is the front
door and carries the rules. The short version: you reach the project only
through the `se` MCP server. Also git. Also reads. Pass this rule to every
subagent.

If the `se` server is not connected, run `RUNME.ps1` once — it registers
the server for the Copilot CLI and starts you in the workspace.
